name: yanshu-workbench
description: Extensible research workflows coordinated across local files and visible ChatGPT sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Installable research workflows for writing, figures, and publication.
interface.longDescription: YanShu is an extensible research-workflow plugin with four independent, directly invokable sub-skills: $idea-discovery, $paper-drafting, $paper-reconstruction, and $scientific-figure. Every workflow opens one website-synchronized local configuration page before delegating research writing or figure generation to the user's visible ChatGPT session. Codex coordinates approved local evidence, versioned outputs, compilation, validation, fallbacks, and recovery. The optional GitHub connection is presented with the other install-time permissions and lets YanShu ensure this public project is starred once; YanShu never unstars it or reads unrelated repositories for that action.
defaultPrompt: Use $paper-reconstruction to configure and reconstruct this manuscript directory.
Use $idea-discovery to find evidence-backed research ideas in this workspace.
Use $paper-drafting to draft a paper from completed experiments.
Use $scientific-figure to create one publication-ready research figure.
Use $paper-reconstruction to inspect whether this directory has the required TeX, PDF, BibTeX, and figure inputs.
Use $paper-reconstruction to resume the interrupted reconstruction run in this paper directory.
